nieuw.titel: Leave enough retreat distance to escape the charge
nieuw.tekst: Before baiting a charge with a unit that will flee, position it so its retreat can carry it beyond the charger's reach, allowing for Swiftstride. Check the retreat angle and the nearby board edge.
nieuw.waarom: He considers a strong Swiftstride charge roll plausible enough that he wants more clearance than the estimated average charge distance.
nieuw.voorbeeld: Against Movement 7 Demigryph Knights with Swiftstride, he wanted the Ellyrian Reavers 18 inches clear after fleeing and needed a retreat of at least six inches.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: His retreat brought the Ellyrian Reavers closer to the board edge, which he identifies as an issue.

bronnen.citaat: I want to be 18 in in the clear

extraCitaten.citaat: I need to be able to get 6 in back at least

nieuw.titel: Flee through a fallback unit to protect the fleeing piece
nieuw.tekst: Position another unit behind a piece you plan to flee with, so the fleeing piece can pass through it to safety. The rear unit can receive a charger that would otherwise reach the fleeing piece.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Lothern Skycutter fled through the Swordmasters of Hoeth. He explains that Demigryph Knights reaching far enough would have hit the Swordmasters of Hoeth instead.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He expects the Swordmasters of Hoeth could take the punishment and be overrun.

bronnen.citaat: flee past the sword Masters here to safety

extraCitaten.citaat: they would have hit the sword Masters instead

nieuw.titel: Use High Elf mobility to flee and change the attack
nieuw.tekst: Use High Elf speed and tactical fleeing to change the point of attack as the game develops. Rally surviving units and manoeuvre them back into useful positions.
nieuw.waarom: He regards the ability to move quickly between flanks as a major advantage for fragile Elf armies. He says the options this creates can confuse the opponent and lead to mistakes.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Ellyrian Reavers fled twice, disrupted the stronger enemy flank and preserved their points. His Lothern Skycutter rallied, returned to the centre and later attacked the crossbowmen and cannon.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that Leadership 8 rallies are probable, but he would not want to make too many of them.

preserve their points so I didn't lose anything from them

nieuw.titel: Use fleeing to deny powerful chargers a reform
nieuw.tekst: Draw powerful enemy units into charges that end without combat by fleeing. He highlights that this denies them a restrain-and-reform opportunity and can leave them unable to turn towards the fight where they are needed.
nieuw.waarom: He sees this as a way to control big hitters that are otherwise highly manoeuvrable.

extraCitaten.citaat: they're not able to then pivot and Enter The Fray

aanvullingen.voorbeeld: He used Ellyrian Reavers as fleeing bait for Demigryph Knights, with a Lothern Skycutter positioned to attack if the Demigryph Knights came too far forward.
aanvullingen.toelichting: The same recommendation to position a decoy so an enemy charging it risks a supporting countercharge.
